result_summary: The shipped norm-only moved flag fires on 4 of 6 untouched statements when one statement is inserted at the top of a 6-statement document, at exactly the four predicted norms 6/42, 5/42, 4/42 and 3/42, while every raw rank displacement stays 0 because the alignment is the monotone shift [1,2,3,4,5,6]; the conjunction (displacement != 0) AND (abs(displacement_norm) > 0.05) fires on 0 of 6. No true positive is paid for that: the worked-example swap pair stays at 2/2, the reversal control stays at 12/12, both 12->8 shrinkage fixtures stay quiet on all 8 kept statements, and across 1,680 reorder-pool permutations over 10 base documents 0 of 13,675 relocated statements lose their flag. Guardrails held: on all 6 fixtures every non-flag field of the details dict is byte-identical across the two definitions, smd and order_gap compare equal exactly, V reads 0/24 on the ibm 11-summary fixture and the shipped smd shows 0 triangle violations in 990 checks. The defect is confirmed and the conjunction is the strictly better estimator in this regime, at the cost of inheriting the raw rank signal's own failure mode when a length change makes the stable-rank alignment non-monotone.
caveats: The conjunction inherits the raw rank displacement's own defect regime: under a length change large enough to make the stable-rank alignment non-monotone, the raw signal turns on and the conjunction reduces to the shipped behaviour. The insertion fixture is a single leading insertion into a 6-statement document; scattered insertion patterns that perturb the alignment were not tested. On the real-text 12->8 shrinkage only 1 of the 4 removed statements exceeded the 0.6 no-counterpart cost, so 1 removed statement reads moved under both definitions; this is outside the bar, which is stated on the 8 kept statements, and those stayed quiet under both. The reorder pool is equal-length permutations, where a rank change and a relative-position change are the same event, so retention there is a consistency check rather than an independent test of the conjunction. Shipping still owes the documentation updates the record names (the pipeline header definitions block and the moved table of docs/example-map-interpretations.md), which were not made because no file under src/ or docs/ may change in this campaign.
